root_cause: Netlify release builds executed static English generation with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY available in build scope. Because the translation cache is not canonical repository state, the release path performed network AI translation during deployment. GitHub CI without the key skipped that path, so CI and Netlify were not executing the same deterministic build contract.
prevention_rule: Production and preview release builds must never call an external translation provider. Static translation generation is an explicit pre-release content-generation task enabled only with STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=1. Netlify release builds pin STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and may only package already-canonical content plus runtime translation capabilities.

evidence.production_readback: Pending protected merge, exact Netlify production deploy and release.json/public route verification.
tests: Exact Netlify build diagnostic proved the release chain is deterministic when external translation is disabled.
